motion: Asset production: ORIGINAL BATHOPHOBIA PLAYER B animation keyframes. Reference image is the approved identity: ash-brown fluffy short hair, small cat ears, emerald eyes, dark green explorer dress, light collar and cuffs, brown belt and hip pouch, brown ankle boots, fine short curved tail. Keep EXACTLY this girl and these proportions in all poses. Do not redesign her face/ears/hair/outfit. Redraw as a simplified REAL LOW-RES PIXEL SPRITE intended to be only FORTY pixels tall in game, 20-pixel environmental tiles: merge hair into 4-6 major tufts, simplify dress folds and boots, small emerald eye, silhouette and pouch are priorities. One flat limited muted palette, square hard pixels, no anti-aliasing, NO glow/haze/shadows/ground/background. Genuine transparent alpha. NOT a smooth illustration or high-resolution painted character. Each key pose is independently redrawn with whole-body weight and silhouette changes, NOT translated/rotated body parts. Side profile faces RIGHT in every cell. Use uniform head size, hair volume, body scale and feet baseline across every cell; head shape and facial features locked. Head/face must not drift between frames. Hair, skirt and tail react with separate delayed shapes. Render the output as a precise rectangular SPRITE SHEET WITH TWO ROWS AND SIX EQUAL COLUMNS, 12 cells total; leave generous transparent gutters and no overlapping sprites, no labels or text. Each equal cell uses a 32:48 aspect; each standing character occupies about 40 of those 48 logical pixel rows, soles on one shared baseline near cell bottom. Same pixel density and same scale in all cells. Show ALL twelve sprites completely. Row1: SIX WALK KEY POSES left-to-right: front heel contact, weight-down compression, rear leg passing under torso, opposite front heel contact, opposite weight-down compression, opposite passing. Grounded controlled strides, counter-swing shoulders/pelvis and delayed skirt/tail. Row2: SIX RUN KEY POSES, distinct from walk: strong push-off with rear boot extended, airborne extended stride with both boots visibly off floor, forward boot impact, compressed contact with flared skirt, rear-leg recovery, opposite extended airborne stride. Forward lean and clearly separated feet, springy readable silhouettes; hair and tail trail behind. Keep contact feet anchored, airborne poses lift within cell rather than being resized. No extra limbs.

Pick has brown wood handle and grey steel head. Show expressive arms, leg weight shifts and torso recoil. No whole-person afterimages, debris, motion arcs or particles painted into this source sheet: renderer adds those.
special:
Create an ORIGINAL Bathophobia B production pixel-animation keyframe sheet. The supplied images are the only identity references: approved ash-brown catgirl Idle and right profile. SAME character: ash-brown fluffy short hair in 4-6 big tufts, low cat ears, emerald eyes, natural compact face, green explorer dress with light collar/cuffs, leather belt and hip pouch, brown ankle boots, slender short tail. Do NOT redesign or enlarge the head: head including ears must occupy about ONE THIRD of standing height, body and legs clearly longer than head; natural roughly 1:3.3 proportions like the reference. Real crisp low-res pixel art meant for 40-pixel-tall sprites, not smooth rendered illustration; simplified folds and boot details, limited muted palette, hard square pixels. Uniform scale, head size, eye placement, outfit and pixel density across EVERY frame. Transparent alpha background, no haze, no shadows, no ground, no text, no labels, no numbers. All figures complete and separated by wide transparent gutters. A precise SHEET of THREE ROWS, SIX EQUAL COLUMNS (18 equal cells); each cell 32:48 aspect and shared near-bottom foot baseline. No limbs leaving their cell.
ROW ONE (left to right): 1) approved gentle 3/4 IDLE with two unequal emerald eyes, relaxed, feet still; 2) same 3/4 idle, subtle shoulder breath only, tail bends slightly later; 3) same idle with BOTH eyes closed for a brief natural blink, cat ears resting differently, feet unchanged; 4) same idle with tail gently to other side and a tiny ear twitch, no whole-body bouncing; 5) side profile RIGHT relaxed STOP stance after walking, 6) half-side TURN pose smoothly between right profile and 3/4 idle (two eyes only partly visible). Foot anchor identical for all.
ROW TWO: SIX distinct RIGHT-facing SWIM strokes: arms reaching ahead/body streamlined, front arm pulls down while legs extend, opposite arm recovers with knees bent, both arms momentarily close as feet kick, opposite reach with legs separated, recovery to streamline. Body clearly swimming, NOT walking in air. Hair and tail FLOAT in different delayed curves. No bubbles/particles baked into sprites.
ROW THREE: 1) HURT right profile, backward torso recoil, ears pressed back, tail curled toward body, 2) recovery from hurt with shoulders still tense, 3) DEATH losing balance with knees folding, 4) falling to the right sideways with hair/skirt/tail trailing but independently redrawn rather than rotating whole sprite, 5) fully down on ground, 6) magical FLY pose right profile floating with knees bent, hair and tail suspended. Do not add magic glows, trails or afterimages; game renderer adds them. Character width can expand in prone pose but same actual body/head scale; no resizing to fill cell.
Preserve B's face, ash-brown hair, green palette and utility pouch. Priority: art-directed readable silhouette and expressive weight changes; not puppet limb shifts.
